Subject: Friday lunch — Design team trade-in: pixels for plates?

Hi Design Team,

Who’s up for trading wireframes for wraps this Friday? I’m putting together a casual team lunch on Friday at 12:30 PM — meet in the main cafeteria (or we can order in if you prefer). Expect good food, better company, and at least one terrible design pun.  

Please RSVP by Thursday 3 PM and let me know any dietary restrictions or location/time preferences. If someone wants to bring a recent project to show off, bonus points (and free applause).

Looking forward to swapping builds for bites,
[Your Name]

P.S. Bring your appetite — and your best one-liner.

Note: I did not send this. Tell me if you want changes (time, place, tone) or if you’d like me to add your name.
